title: 苹果被曝削减内部AI每日预算至$200
originalTitle: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
summary: 苹果将内部AI每日预算从$300降至$200，部分团队或再减至$100。此前行业因'AI tokenmaxxing'热潮导致费用超支，此次调整反映企业对AI成本效益的重新评估。

story.title: Apple cuts AI daily budget for engineering teams, considering $25 cap

author: Lucas Ropek
